events.description: Large crowd in urban street engulfed in dense white smoke (likely tear gas), with individuals running, shielding faces, and holding banners; visible signs of violent unrest and dispersal.

Close-up of a person in protective gear (helmet, gas mask) facing another individual wearing an orange helmet; proximity and posture suggest potential physical confrontation or aggressive interaction, though no direct contact is visible.

A chaotic street scene with multiple individuals in helmets and protective gear, some holding cameras, moving rapidly amid smoke or tear gas; crowd dynamics suggest violent unrest or clashes between groups.
Close-up frames show individuals in helmets and masks physically grappling—arms interlocked, bodies pressed together—in a manner consistent with mutual physical combat.

A person in a black jacket and red scarf appears to be restrained or pushed by multiple others while holding a camera; posture suggests vulnerability and lack of resistance, consistent with targeting of a helpless individual.

A chaotic street confrontation involving multiple individuals in protective gear (helmets, masks), some holding shields or cameras, with visible smoke/tear gas and rapid movement suggesting violent group clashes between protesters and/or security forces.

A man in a red scarf and glasses is physically restrained and pushed by multiple individuals (some wearing helmets/masks) in a coordinated manner; frames f4–f10 show hands grabbing arms, pulling, and shoving, indicating mutual or asymmetric physical combat.

The same man in the red scarf appears overwhelmed and off-balance while being forcibly moved by others; in frames f8–f10, he is pulled sideways with no apparent resistance capacity, and subtitles 'Get on the side.' suggest coercive direction—consistent with attacking a temporarily helpless individual during unrest.

A violent street confrontation between riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields, batons) and a group of protesters/journalists, with visible tear gas/smoke, projectiles being thrown, and aggressive posturing on both sides. The scene shows sustained collective unrest with physical clashes and use of force.

Direct physical engagement: a person in dark clothing and helmet appears to strike or grapple with a police officer holding a shield; another individual is seen mid-motion lunging toward officers. This constitutes mutual physical combat in the context of the broader riot.

Clear physical clash: a protester in dark jacket and helmet is seen swinging an object (possibly a stick or camera rig) at a line of riot police while others press forward; officers respond with batons and shields. Mutual engagement is evident.

A line of riot police in full gear (helmets, shields, batons) advances through heavy smoke on a pedestrian crossing while facing an unseen crowd; visible tension and coordinated movement indicate active crowd control during unrest.

Close-up chaotic scene shows individuals in close physical contact, including one person wearing a white helmet with red cross (suggesting medics or civilians) being jostled or struck amid dense crowd; motion blur suggests struggle, though exact nature is ambiguous.

Wide street view shows large group of people moving rapidly, some running, vehicles stopped or maneuvering, and background buildings suggesting urban protest escalation; consistent with ongoing riot conditions.

A chaotic scene of collective violent unrest in a public square, with multiple individuals running through dense white smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades), some throwing objects, others filming; the environment shows signs of confrontation and dispersal consistent with a riot.

In frame f4 (122.0s) and f5 (122.5s), two individuals in the center appear to engage in close physical contact—one raises an arm toward the other in a striking motion while both are moving rapidly amid smoke; this suggests mutual physical combat, though obscured by smoke and motion blur.

In frames f13–f15, one individual (center-right, dark clothing) holds an object resembling a firearm and appears to aim and fire; however, no muzzle flash, projectile, or recoil is visible, and the object’s identity is ambiguous due to low resolution and smoke. This is speculative and low-confidence.

A group of individuals in a public square are actively moving through and away from dense white smoke (consistent with tear gas or smoke grenades), indicating a violent unrest or clash. Some wear masks/gear; one individual is seen throwing an object at 130.0s (f4). The scene shows collective, agitated movement amid deployed crowd-control agents, satisfying the definition of riot as collective violent unrest.

A crowd of people is seen moving through dense smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) in an urban street setting; individuals are covering faces, retreating, and reacting to irritants, consistent with a riot or protest escalation involving crowd control measures.

A large group of people in a public square are engaged in violent unrest, with dense smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) filling the area; individuals are seen running, covering faces, and moving erratically amid the haze, consistent with a riot involving crowd dispersal tactics.

A large group of people, many wearing masks and dark clothing, are engaged in collective unrest in an open urban plaza. Thick white smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) is deployed across the area, causing dispersal and agitation. Individuals are seen running, shielding faces, and moving erratically amid the smoke. The scene shows sustained chaotic movement and confrontation consistent with a riot.

A police officer (marked '4A') is seen striking or forcefully pushing a person lying on the ground near a silver car, while other officers stand nearby; the person on the ground appears helpless and non-resisting.

Sustained violent group confrontation: multiple riot police in full gear engage with civilians; one civilian is restrained by several officers (frames f12–f15), while others are seated or crouched on the sidewalk under apparent duress (frames f3–f10); a sign reading '1er MAI' indicates a May Day context, and the scene shows active crowd control with physical coercion and tension.

A group of riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields, body armor) engage with protesters in a street confrontation; officers are seen restraining individuals, advancing, and forming lines while protesters resist or are detained. A sign reading '1er MAI' (May Day) is visible, indicating a protest context.

A person in a red jacket is bent over, head down, while another individual (face blurred) appears to be holding or pressing them down; the posture suggests vulnerability and possible physical coercion in a crowded setting, though no overt striking is visible.

A group of riot police in full protective gear (helmets, vests with unit markings like '1C', '4B', '4A') are actively engaging and pushing against a crowd of civilians near a building entrance; a sign reading '1er MAI' is visible, indicating May Day context. The interaction involves physical pressure, containment, and apparent arrests or detentions, consistent with violent group clashes.

In frames f0–f2, multiple officers are seen physically restraining at least one individual: one officer (unit '1C') has hands on a person’s upper body while others surround and push; the person appears to be resisting or being forcibly moved. This constitutes mutual or asymmetric physical combat in close quarters.

At ~197.5–198.5s (frames f2–f4), an individual (partially obscured, wearing dark jacket) is held against a wall by multiple officers while appearing subdued and unable to resist; one officer's posture suggests excessive force (e.g., pressing head/shoulder into wall). The victim shows no capacity to defend themselves during this interval.
